subject: SIG/SOC2: request for penetration test report + evidence bundle
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-15 09:12 PST
Subject: SIG/SOC2 evidence request — PT report + remediation status

Hi Aditya / Hannah,

Acme is working to close our SIG submission this week and we need the latest penetration test report and accompanying evidence for a few controls. Specifically:
- Full pen-test report (PDF) and executive summary for non-technical reviewers
- Asset mapping that ties scoped hosts/services to the report findings
- Remediation status for high/critical findings (CVE ids, PR/patch references)
- Evidence of configuration/hardening (auth flow, encryption at rest, network diagrams)

Can you confirm what’s available and a timeline to deliver a ZIP bundle or Drive folder? We need this by EOB Monday (2026-11-22) to stay on our SIG timeline.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Security Program Manager | Acme Corporation
security@acme.com

---
Attachments: none listed

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15 10:05 PST
Subject: Fwd: SIG/SOC2 evidence request — PT report + remediation status

Team — routing incoming request from Acme (below). Can you split ownership so we can deliver an evidence bundle by EOB Mon 11/22? Proposed owners:

- Monica (Security ops): Pull the canonical pen-test report and produce a short executive summary (1 page) + inventory CSV that maps assets mentioned in the PT to our asset ids.
- Vivek (Eng): Confirm remediation status for high/critical findings. For each finding please provide: CVE or finding id, PR/commit/patch reference, date deployed to prod, and any compensating controls if unresolved.
- Hannah (CS): Coordinate timeline with Acme and confirm acceptable delivery format (ZIP vs Drive link) and any redactions they require.

Action items / timeline:
- Monica: deliver report + asset CSV draft by Tue 11/16 EOD PST
- Vivek: patch log + status by Thu 11/18 EOD PST
- Hannah: confirm delivery format with Acme and preferred reviewers by Mon 11/16 noon PST

I’ve copied minimal context above. If you need additional logs (e.g., SIEM extracts) let me know — we can pull from infra but want to keep scope tight for the SIG ask.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16 08:30 PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG/SOC2 evidence request — PT report + remediation status

Aditya / Hannah — I pulled the canonical pen-test PDF and started the asset reconciliation. Quick notes:

- redwood_pt_report_2026-10.pdf: full report is available (internal repo + final signed PDF). I’ll create a 1-page executive summary for Acme (succinct risk + status).
- asset-inventory-20261116.csv: mapping of assets referenced in the report to our internal asset ids (hostname, service, owner). Draft attached.
- auth-flow-diagram.png: current auth/dataflow diagram for the scoped environment (attached).

Question for Vivek: The report references three high findings tied to auth service and an outdated library on the inference API nodes. Do you have the PRs/commits that remediate those so I can include links in the CSV? If any fix is still pending, please include a mitigation note.

I’m tagging the S3/secure storage locations for artifacts. I will assemble everything into a folder and hand to Hannah once Vivek confirms patch references.

Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: asset-inventory-20261116.csv, auth-flow-diagram.png

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18 14:20 PST
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG/SOC2 evidence request — PT report + remediation status

Confirming remediation status for the high/critical findings referenced in the PT:

- FIND-2026-HT01 (auth-token-reuse): Fixed. PR #4821 (commit 7a3bcd9), deployed to prod 2026-11-12. Evidence: deploy tag + unit/integration test run.
- FIND-2026-HT02 (third-party lib vuln CVE-2026-3112): Fixed in PR #4893, backported to inference nodes, deployed to canary 2026-11-15 and prod 2026-11-17. Patch-log attached.
- FIND-2026-HT03 (privilege-escalation pattern): Mitigated with WAF rule and config change; full code remediation scheduled for 2026-12-03 (sprint 52). Compensating control details included below.

I’ve attached patch-log-20261118.xlsx with PR references and deployment timestamps. For the scheduled fix (HT03) we can provide the Jira card and a temporary mitigation evidence bundle (WAF config exports + monitoring alerts showing blocked attempts).

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure Engineering | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: patch-log-20261118.xlsx
